AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Rescue commando
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] team were recognized as the very best for hostile extractions. [PAWN_pronoun] has led operations to rescue military brass, political figures, and civilians.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Alien fighter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Life changed for [PAWN_nameDef] when [PAWN_possessive] team was targeted by a strange, powerful alien hunter. It decimated most of his unit, before [PAWN_nameDef] defeated it in hand-to-hand combat.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Soldier and agent
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began [PAWN_possessive] career leading a small strike force of commandos on multiple successful strike missions. [PAWN_pronoun] was then recruited by the Logann Office of Strategic Services, and further trained and sent on many more missions of infiltration and intrigue.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: SWORD director
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] eventually became head of the mysterious organization known as SWORD - a vast covert agency devoted to protecting the Logann people secretly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OSA agent
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] truly began [PAWN_possessive] career when [PAWN_pronoun] was recruited by the Office of Secret Actions (OSA), investigating rumors of occult activity by the Third Reich's SS Paranormal Division.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Top agent
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The missions that [PAWN_nameDef] participated in include assassinating a series of leaders of Axis bio-chemical warfare research programs, defeating various plots to use strange occult artifacts for evil ends, and eventually killing Adolf Hitler himself.
